task.description: Rework REQ-226's design to remove the literal Ecto schema DSL block CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR found in §3.2.

result.note: Replaced §3.2's literal `@primary_key {...}` + `schema "entity_definitions" do ... field ... timestamps(...) end` block with a non-compilable field-shape table: a primary-key sentence (id, :binary_id, autogenerate) plus a Field/Ecto-field-type/Source-column table cross-referencing each field to its §1.2 DB column, and a prose sentence for the timestamps option -- same information content, no schema/field/timestamps macro syntax. Did a full-document scan (grep '^```' across the whole file) of all remaining fenced blocks: every one is a @type/@spec declaration (create_attrs/create_error/create_definition, get_definition/get_definition_by_name specs, list_definitions_filters/list_definitions spec, activate_definition spec) -- none contain def...do...end or schema...do...end bodies. No other violations found; nothing else needed changing since the validator's PASS covered the rest of the document (AC traceability, function-signature accuracy, tenant-scoping, error taxonomy) unchanged from the prior iteration.
